milestone.title: Push v1.0.0-rc1 tag and bump homebrew-tap Formula/lazybrew.rb

intent.outcome: v1.0.0-rc1 is published: tag on origin (GitHub), tap formula in lthiagol/homebrew-tap points at the rc1 tarball with the correct sha256. Users running `brew upgrade` on the tap get rc1.

problem.description: v1.0.0-rc1 exists locally on wip (commit 71af1a1) but not pushed to origin. The tap Formula/lazybrew.rb still points at v0.2.0 on Codeberg (stale URL host: the project moved to GitHub per origin remote). Without this milestone, the rc1 release is not actually available to users.

in_scope: User pushes local v1.0.0-rc1 tag to origin (GitHub) — irreversible public action, user-driven per agreement.
Agent drafts Formula/lazybrew.rb diff (URL host codeberg.org → github.com, tag v0.2.0 → v1.0.0-rc1, sha256 placeholder).
User computes the tarball sha256 by running `curl -sL <url> | shasum -a 256` and pastes it to the agent.
Agent applies the diff to a clone of lthiagol/homebrew-tap, commits, opens a PR against :stable.
Agent verifies the merged formula via raw GitHub URL.
out_of_scope: Cutting the stable v1.0.0 tag (separate milestone after rc1 ships and any rc1-only fixes land).
Updating Formula/lazybrew-dev.rb (separate track per AGENTS.md; not part of rc1 release).
Coverage floor decision (separate M03 — not blocking rc1 if floors are documented as pre-existing).

acceptance_criteria.description: v1.0.0-rc1 tag is present on origin (GitHub).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -E 'v1\.0\.0-rc1\s' returns a 40-char SHA
acceptance_criteria.evidence: git ls-remote --tags origin | grep 'v1.0.0-rc1' returns '71af1a1c6bd9b915f6b3d0d0c3b8f98d7fb0fe3a refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1^{}' (commit matches local HEAD on wip); gh api repos/lthiagol/lazybrew/git/refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1 returns same ref

acceptance_criteria.description: Formula/lazybrew.rb sha256 matches the rc1 tarball bytes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: curl -sL https://github.com/lthiagol/lazybrew/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1.tar.gz | shasum -a 256 returns the same value as the formula's sha256 line
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Formula on stable: sha256 'cd5e29ee3f1d384e13a23eba88f56e41a4c28cb13bfdefbb24b5710569e7ba19'. Fresh download: curl -sL https://github.com/lthiagol/lazybrew/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1.tar.gz | shasum -a 256 = 'cd5e29ee3f1d384e13a23eba88f56e41a4c28cb13bfdefbb24b5710569e7ba19'. Byte-for-byte match.

acceptance_criteria.description: Formula/lazybrew.rb URL host switched from codeberg.org to github.com/lthiagol/lazybrew.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lthiagol/homebrew-tap/stable/Formula/lazybrew.rb | grep '^  url ' shows github.com host
acceptance_criteria.evidence: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lthiagol/homebrew-tap/stable/Formula/lazybrew.rb | grep '^  url ' returns 'url "https://github.com/lthiagol/lazybrew/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1.tar.gz"'. grep -c codeberg against formula returns 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: A PR is opened against lthiagol/homebrew-tap:stable with the formula change.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: gh pr list --repo lthiagol/homebrew-tap --state open --base stable shows a PR titled 'lazybrew: bump to v1.0.0-rc1' (or similar) with the URL and sha256 changes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: gh pr view 9 --repo lthiagol/homebrew-tap: state=MERGED, mergedAt=2026-08-01T17:38:46Z, mergeCommit=9a58398c4d21d25a88a9a0dcf4dcb479ec00759f, url=https://github.com/lthiagol/homebrew-tap/pull/9

steps.action: Wait for user to push the v1.0.0-rc1 tag to origin (GitHub). Verify via git ls-remote --tags origin.
steps.tests: manual: git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -E 'v1\.0\.0-rc1\s' returns a SHA
steps.done_when: git ls-remote --tags origin shows a SHA for refs/tags/v1.0.0-rc1.

steps.action: User runs curl|shasum on the rc1 tarball to compute the sha256, pastes the value to the agent. Agent drafts the Formula/lazybrew.rb diff (URL host codeberg->github, tag v0.2.0->v1.0.0-rc1, sha256) in a scratch file.
steps.tests: manual: scratch file exists with formula diff showing github URL and rc1 tag
steps.done_when: Scratch file contains the new Formula/lazybrew.rb body with github URL, rc1 tag, and the user-provided sha256.

steps.action: Agent clones lthiagol/homebrew-tap, creates branch bump-lazybrew-v1.0.0-rc1, applies the formula diff, commits, pushes branch, opens PR against :stable via gh.
steps.tests: manual: gh pr list --repo lthiagol/homebrew-tap --state open --base stable shows the PR
steps.done_when: gh pr list returns the bump PR with title containing 'v1.0.0-rc1' and the URL/sha256 changes.

steps.action: After PR is merged by the tap maintainer, verify the formula via raw GitHub URL: URL host is github.com, sha256 matches the tarball.
steps.tests: manual: curl raw formula, grep URL host and sha256; re-run curl|shasum on tarball to confirm match
steps.done_when: curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lthiagol/homebrew-tap/stable/Formula/lazybrew.rb shows github URL and matching sha256.

verification.evidence: M06 self-verification: tag pushed (AC-01), PR opened+merged (AC-04), stable formula verified (AC-02 sha256 match, AC-03 github URL host). Merged via user click (PAT lacked merge scope); merge commit 9a58398c4d21d25a88a9a0dcf4dcb479ec00759f.
